name: Demolition Boys
notes: Billed as Xplosion!'s most recent acquisitions when introduced on 4 March 2007, winning their debut over JG Revolution and a Tag-Team Ladder Elimination Match over Salvador and Mike24 on 11 March 2007.
caption: A recently-acquired Xplosion! tag team that won its first two outings, over JG Revolution and then Salvador and Mike24.

name: JG Revolution
notes: Lost an Elimination Tag Team Match to the Demolition Boys on 4 March 2007, Jlaest pinned first and CD-Generation disqualified for using a chair.
caption: A tag team eliminated in full by the Demolition Boys on SWWE Fed's own 4 March 2007 card.

name: Rated-X
notes: Billed as SWWE Fed's own Xtreme Tag Team Champions by the promotion's own 29 April 2007 card.
caption: Rated Xtreme and Felix619's own tag pairing, billed as SWWE Fed's Xtreme Tag Team Champions through the promotion's own April 2007 card.
